```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Packages ---------------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(ggforce)
library(ggtext)
library(scales)

# Data -------------------------------------------------------------------

basotho_wool <- readr::read_csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-08-04/basotho_wool.csv"
)

plot_data <- basotho_wool |>
  summarise(
    annual_value = sum(primary_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(reporter_desc, ref_year)
  )

country_totals <- plot_data |>
  summarise(total_value = sum(annual_value), .by = reporter_desc) |>
  arrange(desc(total_value)) |>
  mutate(
    country_id = row_number(),
    country_color = c("#d95d39", "#236b73", "#d8a72d", "#6b5ca5")
  )

plot_data <- plot_data |>
  left_join(country_totals, by = join_by(reporter_desc)) |>
  complete(
    nesting(
      reporter_desc,
      total_value,
      country_id,
      country_color
    ),
    ref_year = 2010:2024
  ) |>
  mutate(
    has_record = !is.na(annual_value)
  )

# Miscs ------------------------------------------------------------------

color_paper <- "#f5efe5"
color_ink <- "#392f2a"
chart_font <- "Gill Sans"

theme_set(
  theme_void(base_size = 15, base_family = chart_font) +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = color_paper, color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = color_paper, color = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(
        family = chart_font,
        color = color_ink,
        face = "bold",
        size = 30,
        margin = margin(b = 14)
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_textbox_simple(
        family = chart_font,
        color = "#665a51",
        size = 16,
        lineheight = 1.15,
        hjust = 0,
        halign = 0,
        valign = 1,
        width = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
        padding = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        margin = margin(b = 18),
        fill = NA,
        box.colour = NA
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        family = chart_font,
        color = "#74685e",
        size = 9.5,
        hjust = 0,
        lineheight = 1.15,
        margin = margin(t = 14)
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(25, 35, 35, 35)
    )
)

# Texts ------------------------------------------------------------------

source_note <- paste(
  "Source: UN Comtrade via TidyTuesday (2026-08-04).| Graphic: Deepali Kank"
)

total_trade <- sum(country_totals$total_value)
top_two_value <- sum(slice_head(country_totals, n = 2)$total_value)
top_two_share <- top_two_value / total_trade
```

## Two markets dominate the recorded value

Each country is a dense panel of the same narrow V-stitch, attached to the same
pair of needles and hanging downward. Only the panel length changes. The chart
uses a logarithmic length scale so the two smaller destinations remain visible
alongside the much larger South African and Chinese totals.

```{r}
#| label: knitted-trade
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: 100%

# Plots ------------------------------------------------------------------

stitch_height <- 0.5
knit_top <- 14.7

country_labels <- country_totals |>
  mutate(
    total_label = dollar(total_value, scale_cut = cut_short_scale()),
    height_units = (log10(total_value) - 5) / 0.25,
    row_count = pmax(2L, as.integer(round(height_units / stitch_height))),
    knit_bottom = knit_top - row_count * stitch_height
  )

stitch_data <- country_labels |>
  tidyr::uncount(row_count, .id = "row_number") |>
  tidyr::crossing(
    cable_number = 1:5,
    side = c(-1, 1),
    t = seq(0, 1, length.out = 28)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cable_x = country_id + (cable_number - 3) * 0.14,
    x = cable_x + side * 0.068 * sin(pi * t),
    y = knit_top - (row_number - 1 + t) * stitch_height,
    stitch_id = str_c(
      reporter_desc,
      row_number,
      cable_number,
      side,
      sep = "_"
    )
  )

attachment_data <- country_labels |>
  tidyr::crossing(cable_number = 1:5) |>
  mutate(
    x = country_id + (cable_number - 3) * 0.14,
    y = knit_top,
    yend = 15.36
  )

value_guides <- tibble(
  guide_value = c(1e5, 1e6, 1e7, 1e8),
  y = knit_top - (log10(guide_value) - 5) / 0.25,
  label = dollar(guide_value, scale_cut = cut_short_scale())
)

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(
    data = value_guides,
    aes(yintercept = y),
    color = "#ddd1c3",
    linewidth = 0.45,
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = country_labels,
    aes(
      xmin = country_id - 0.36,
      xmax = country_id + 0.36,
      ymin = knit_bottom,
      ymax = knit_top,
      fill = I(country_color)
    ),
    color = color_ink,
    linewidth = 0.75,
    alpha = 0.14
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = stitch_data,
    aes(x, y, group = stitch_id),
    color = color_ink,
    linewidth = 2.25,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = stitch_data,
    aes(x, y, group = stitch_id, color = I(country_color)),
    linewidth = 1.25,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = attachment_data,
    aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y, yend = yend),
    color = color_ink,
    linewidth = 2.25,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = attachment_data,
    aes(
      x = x,
      xend = x,
      y = y,
      yend = yend,
      color = I(country_color)
    ),
    linewidth = 1.25,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 0.38,
    xend = 4.55,
    y = 15.35,
    yend = 15.35,
    color = color_ink,
    linewidth = 2.15,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 0.48,
    xend = 4.66,
    y = 15.68,
    yend = 15.68,
    color = color_ink,
    linewidth = 2.15,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "point",
    x = c(4.58, 4.69),
    y = c(15.35, 15.68),
    shape = 21,
    size = 7,
    stroke = 1.4,
    color = color_ink,
    fill = color_paper
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = country_labels,
    aes(
      country_id,
      knit_bottom - 1.18,
      label = reporter_desc,
      color = I(country_color)
    ),
    family = chart_font,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.9,
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = country_labels,
    aes(country_id, knit_bottom - 0.62, label = total_label),
    family = chart_font,
    color = color_ink,
    fill = color_paper,
    label.size = 0,
    label.padding = grid::unit(0.12, "lines"),
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.65
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = value_guides,
    aes(0.4, y, label = label),
    color = "#786b61",
    size = 3.1,
    hjust = 1
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0.04, 4.92),
    ylim = c(-1.45, 16.05),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "A Trade Woven from Lesotho",
    subtitle = "The country’s wool trade connected local production to markets across southern Africa and Asia. Reported import values show where Lesotho’s wool travelled and how much each destination received.",
    caption = str_wrap(source_note, width = 125)
  )

p
```
